--- a/.github/workflows/environment.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/environment.yml
@@ -130,9 +130,20 @@ jobs:
           path: resources/foundry/
       - run: python3 -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --retries 1 --timeout 20 -r tools/requirements_art.txt
         timeout-minutes: 2
-      # Evidence is part of the frozen input: four isolated full checkouts would
-      # duplicate several GiB each. Run the identical fresh checks in one lane.
-      - run: python3 tools/harness.py --profile gameplay --profile art --jobs 1 --release
+      - name: Record resources for two isolated validation lanes
+        run: |
+          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/harness-lanes" build/verification/harness
+          {
+            df -h "$RUNNER_TEMP" "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
+            du -sh "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.git"
+            free -h
+            nproc
+          } | tee build/verification/harness/resource-preflight.log
+      # Two existing isolated lanes retain the complete fresh profiles.
+      # The 18 serial consumers remain ordered; the 60-minute cap is unchanged.
+      - run: python3 tools/harness.py --profile gameplay --profile art --jobs 2 --release
+        env:
+          TMPDIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/harness-lanes
       - name: Show failed Harness checks without requiring artifact download
         if: failure()
         run: |
